notes.title: 3..2..1..Grenades! Update 1.01!!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! Just wanted to let you all know that I've pushed an update for 321!! This update includes some bug fixes, and even better... a whole new map!

Updates
- A new map! Ice Cave

A Wide open map with lots of levels. Take the elevators to the top or the quick route, through one of the Teleporters inside the house.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/krfiPJ5.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/BRFM3qM.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/nKhJsUV.png[/img]

Fixes 
- Achievements should be fixed.
- Bug where you could randomly fall through the level geometry is fixed.
- Inverted aim
- Camera overlay when you're dead doesn't show black bar.
- Settings menu navigation order was messed up when using keyboard.
-

notes.title: 360 Streaming
notes.content:
A nifty feature of 321 is the ability to stream a 360 video to a second monitor. I thought I'd make a post on how to get that all set up

If you want to see what I mean by 360 video [url=https://youtu.be/4I6eZU8EJ_Q]check this video out[/url]

Firstly you need a 2nd monitor!

Once you're in the game enable 360 stream by setting this option in the settings to YES

[img]http://i.imgur.com/F3IZwfW.png[/img]

Then when you start a match the second monitor will get a feed that looks like this. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Z6wvWXw.png[/img]

This camera will follow players around on it's own!

You'll need to capture that screen to a video somehow. OBS or Fraps or however you want really. 

Then grab the 360 video meta data injector from Youtube's 360 tutorial [url=https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6178631?hl=en]HERE[/url]

Youtube's instructions are pretty good on creating the video (Step 2) so I'll leave the reading to you. But all you have to do is run their tool on the video you recorded and then it spits out a "360 injected meta data" movie. 

Once that's done, all you have left to do is upload the injected video to youtube and enjoy!
